'''Stonebull Lake''' is a long horseshoe-shaped lake that surrounds [[Bloodhoof Village]] in central [[Mulgore]] on three sides. It is known for its abundant fish, and many an hour is spent casting lines into the cool water. A bridge spans the lake at its narrowest point. The road that crosses this bridge connects [[Thunder Bluff]] to Bloodhoof Village.
